description: This file declares helper functions and templates for correctly sending and receiving file descriptors over Unix domain sockets, encapsulating the complexities of the cmsg API to prevent common mistakes.

methods.name: SendFileDescriptorVector
methods.description: Sends file descriptors along with data over a Unix socket using the cmsg API.

methods.name: ReceiveFileDescriptorVector
methods.description: Receives file descriptors and data from a Unix socket, handling errors if received more than expected.

methods.name: ssize_t SendFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock,const void * data,size_t len,Args &&...sent_fds)
methods.description: Template helper that constructs a vector of FDs and calls SendFileDescriptorVector.

methods.name: ssize_t ReceiveFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock,void * data,size_t len,Args &&...received_fds)
methods.description: Template helper that receives a specified number of file descriptors and assigns them to provided unique_fd objects.

ctags.name: ReceiveFileDescriptors
ctags.pattern: /^ssize_t ReceiveFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock, void* data, size_t len, Args&&... received_fds)/

ctags.name: SendFileDescriptors
ctags.pattern: /^ssize_t SendFileDescriptors(borrowed_fd sock, const void* data, size_t len, Args&&... sent_fds) /
